messages:
alyssa: quick sync 1 proposing a 'softbind' binding mode to simplify pin TTL semantics. want to align on telemetry, resolver headers, and migration before I push RFC updates.

mike: short summary?

alyssa: softbind = prefer pinned variant but allow runtime to transparently use a compatible model when preferred is unavailable (capacity/compat). hardbind = strict: runtime returns 409 if the requested variant cannot be resolved. goal: make softbind the default for rollouts to reduce noisy failures.

jia: how do we prevent silent quality regressions when softbind falls back? we need clear signals for when fallback occurs so evals/alerts can catch regressions.

alyssa: agree. propose emitting per-request telemetry fields: bind.outcome (preferred|compatible|fallback), bind.reason (capacity|compat|notfound), bind.latency.delta_ms (number), and X-Model-Resolved header. also aggregate bind_fallback_rate per-rollout and link to evaluation prompt-sets for regression detection.

samir: enterprise/compliance customers will need hard guarantees. add a rollout metadata flag (binding: hard|soft) and allow tenant-level override to default to hard. also we need a migration path for existing pinned leases.

anya: devex will document SDK behavior. SDKs should read X-Model-Resolved and X-Bind-Outcome headers and optionally surface a warning or increment a client-side metric.

mike: router details 1 preference ordering vs weighted choices?

alyssa: rollout metadata will contain ordered buckets: preferred, compatible, fallback. router picks first available in order; optional weights can be added later. sample metadata: { binding: \"soft\", preferred: [\"model-A@v1.3.2\"], compatible: [\"model-A@v1.2.x\",\"model-A-quant@v1.3.2-q4\"], fallback_policy: \"ordered\" }.

jia: recommend adding a resolver header that includes resolved id + outcome so logs trace which model served each request. also add a tiny eval harness that replays a small prompt-set through resolved variants when fallback happens.

samir: ops: add metrics bind_fallsback_total, bind_forced_409_total, bind_fallback_rate_by_tenant. set SLO alarm when per-tenant fallback_rate > 0.5% over 5m for high-traffic tenants.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout model-A v1.3.2 -> v1.4.0 started (5% traffic), binding=soft.

anya: I'll take doc PR for SDK header handling and a migration guide for mapping old pin TTLs to binding semantics. proposal: TTL==infinite -> hardbind, else convert to softbind with remaining ttl carried as hint.

mike: add compatibility shim: if client supplies explicit model-id header, treat that as hardbind for that request even if rollout binding is soft. document in SDKs.

jia: +1 to telemetry, headers, and the eval harness. also suggest a lightweight regression alert that ties fallback events to prompt-set degradation + increased latency delta.

alyssa: action items: update RFC with new fields (binding, preferred/compatible/fallback lists), telemetry spec (bind.outcome/reason/latency.delta_ms), resolver headers (X-Model-Resolved, X-Bind-Outcome), ops metrics, and migration notes. plan: make softbind default for non-enterprise tenants in 2 weeks, with tenant override available. will ping arch for sign-off after RFC update.

mike: ack. please include a compact example of old-pin -> binding migration in the RFC.

alyssa: will do, thanks everyone.
